trigger: Native binary Rank1/Rank5 reproduced R1, but open-set flags differed. Reproduced a NumPy2 strict-threshold rounding defect with tied float32 scores.
correction: Convert exact integer Hamming scores to float64 before comparison with a nextafter(float64) strict threshold. No model, seed, cohort, score, tie rule, calibration allowed count or unknown selection changes.
affected: New binary_frontend ITQ/centering and both FaceNet/SFace projection studies. Frozen R1 and generated SFace native evaluators already use float64 scores and remain unchanged.
validation: Every existing closed-set Rank1 and Rank5 flag remains identical. Corrected native float/sign open-set flags must reproduce original R1/SFace native archives exactly for all sizes, splits, rules and identities. Actual calibration acceptance count must never exceed allowed5 or1. Unit boundaries include all-equal scores and independently checked Hamming matrix.
outputs: New results/*_corrected directories. Preserve old models, protocols, scripts and outputs as original attempts; never pool unsafe open-set arrays with corrected arrays.
downstream: Cross-frontend paired open-set comparisons must use corrected FaceNet/SFace archives. All prior open-set improvement claims from the affected attempts are provisional until corrected, including ITQ/centering DIR deltas. Closed-set accuracy and MPC timings are unaffected.
